description: The Avrana shell's colour tokens as the Games copy them (AVR-291): the `avrana` theme and @theme tokens of avrana-party web/src/party.css, under the same names, at the Party commit named below. web/shared.css (the pre-game layer) and web/avrana-integration.css (the Back to Party bar and what hubnet.js draws in it) each declare the subset they use; tests/test_platform_palette.py holds every declaration to this file, and this file to Party's own party.css when a checkout is available. To follow a Party change: update the three places together and re-run that test.
